arguments.summary: A credential compromise occurred on host WS-FIN-AP01, initiated via a phishing email that triggered an encoded PowerShell command from Outlook.exe. This led to the execution of a malicious DLL using rundll32.exe from the user's Temp directory. The payload established C2 communication over TCP/443 to 198.51.100.23 and modified the host file. The external IP 185.220.101.42 was previously observed conducting an Nmap SYN scan against an internal IT asset (WS-IT-101). Despite detection by EDR and NDR tools, response actions were denied due to policy or validation issues.
